container_command:
set -euo pipefail
ulimit -c 0
unset VITE_MODEL_CATALOG_URL GINFER_MODEL_CATALOG_URL IS_DEV NODE_OPTIONS NODE_ENV FORCE_ONBOARDING FRESH_INSTALL FORCE_HARDWARE_TIER TAURI_CONFIG TAURI_DEV_HOST TAURI_ENV_DEBUG IS_IOS IS_ANDROID IS_CLEAN CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS CARGO_BUILD_TARGET RUSTFLAGS GINFER_PROFILE_CATALOGS CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
run_stage() {
 stage="$1"; shift
 date -u +%FT%TZ > "/work/${stage}.start"
 if "$@" > "/work/${stage}.log" 2>&1; then code=0; else code=$?; fi
 printf '%s\n' "$code" > "/work/${stage}.exit"
 date -u +%FT%TZ > "/work/${stage}.end"
 return "$code"
}
run_stage actionable-recovery-launcher cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml --lib launcher::tests::old_installed_configuration_requires_actionable_reinstallation -- --exact --test-threads=1
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; s=Path("/work/actionable-recovery-launcher.log").read_text(); assert "test launcher::tests::old_installed_configuration_requires_actionable_reinstallation ... ok" in s and "1 passed" in s'
run_stage actionable-recovery-preparation cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml --bin ginfer-host tests::installed_preparation_reports_the_shared_reinstallation_guidance -- --exact --test-threads=1
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; s=Path("/work/actionable-recovery-preparation.log").read_text(); assert "test tests::installed_preparation_reports_the_shared_reinstallation_guidance ... ok" in s and "1 passed" in s'
run_stage actionable-recovery-check cargo check --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml --bin ginfer-host
run_stage actionable-recovery-clippy cargo clippy --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml --all-targets
run_stage actionable-recovery-release cargo build --locked --offline --release --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml --bin ginfer-host
install -m755 /work/native-target/release/ginfer-host /work/bin/ginfer-host
run_stage actionable-recovery-package python3 scripts/package-ginfer-host.py --binary /work/bin/ginfer-host --target linux-x86_64 --runtime-directory /engine-runtime --profile-catalog /launch-profiles.json --output-dir /work/distribution-actionable-recovery
sha256sum /work/bin/ginfer-host /work/distribution-actionable-recovery/ginfer-bundle-0.1.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz /work/packaging-guide-combined.md > /work/actionable-recovery-artifacts.sha256
ldd /work/bin/ginfer-host > /work/actionable-recovery-host-ldd.txt
! grep -q 'not found' /work/actionable-recovery-host-ldd.txt
